parsed.explanation: No trans-specific presentation offence or documented universal facility ban, and foreign-government note says state persecution unlikely, so not 0.15-0.25 state-campaign tier. But outed visitor faces patterned lethal targeting: repeated close-range/highway killings of trans women in largest city in Nov 2024 and Sep 2025, plus Feb 2026 shooting, with fear to go out and no documented prosecutions or denominator to discount as background violence. State threat-framing by religious court portraying trans women as disguised rapists, police suspicion/ridicule, hospital/service dismissal and legal-aid finding of implementation failure show thin recourse. Resident self-ID/X-marker is only a climate signal, undermined by unresolved strike-down and proposed re-assignment board. Patterned identity killings plus impunity place this below 0.35 service-discrimination tier.
